articles.title: Delhi to Roll Out 1,300 Pink Electric Autos Driven by Women and Transgender Drivers
articles.excerpt: The DURGA scheme makes women and transgender beneficiaries owners as well as drivers, combining self-employment with safer, cleaner last-mile transport in the capital.
articles.image_caption: An auto rickshaw (file photo) — Delhi’s DURGA E-Auto Scheme will roll out 1,300 pink electric autos driven by women and transgender drivers in its first phase.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora visiting Delhi, the pink DURGA-branded e-autos will become a recognizable, safer last-mile option; for families in the capital, the scheme opens a path to vehicle ownership for women and transgender relatives.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Electric Blue Waves: Chennai's Beaches Are Glowing — Here's How to Catch It
articles.excerpt: Surfers and fishermen report the sea lighting up electric blue off Kovalam and Thiruvanmiyur this month. The plankton behind it is unpredictable — but here's when and where to look.
articles.image_caption: Bioluminescent waves glow electric blue at night. Chennai's beaches have been lighting up with the plankton phenomenon — here's how to catch it.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs visiting Chennai this winter can catch the glow at Kovalam or Thiruvanmiyur in the pre-dawn hours — a rare, free, magical reason to plan a late-night beach trip during the monsoon months.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.image_caption: Heritage architecture in Lucknow, home to a restored 1949 heritage house where slow living takes centre stage.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs planning roots trips to Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow's restored heritage homes — and the growing heritage-stay category — offer a way to live the slow aesthetic rather than just photograph it.

articles.title: Air India Offers Students 10% Off Domestic Fares; Book by October 20
articles.excerpt: The limited-time student fare discount runs through October 20, with direct-booking perks and UPI savings on top; year-round benefits include extra baggage and one free date change.
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft on the tarmac
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora students flying home to India for Diwali get the limited-time 10% discount plus a free date change on international bookings — the most valuable perk on pricey India–US/UK sectors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.image_caption: The lighthouse at Galle Fort, Sri Lanka, at sunset

articles.title: Air India, Akasa Hike Fuel Surcharges Just as Diwali Travel Peaks
articles.excerpt: Domestic surcharges now reach ₹1,200 per leg and North America–India flights carry $215 each way, as all four major carriers raise charges within four days on soaring jet fuel prices.
articles.image_caption: Air India aircraft parked at an airport gate. The airline raised fuel surcharges on all new bookings from October 9, with domestic legs now carrying ₹400-₹1,200 extra.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora flyers heading home for Diwali face higher fares across all Indian carriers: up to $215 per leg in fuel surcharges on North America–India routes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India, IndiGo and Lufthansa Suspend Riyadh Flights After Houthi Missile Strike on Airport
articles.excerpt: Nearly half of all departures from Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport were cancelled Thursday as airlines pulled out after Yemen's Houthis claimed a ballistic missile attack on the Saudi capital's airport.
articles.image_caption: A departure board shows cancelled flights at an international airport. Airlines suspended Riyadh services on October 8, 2026, after the Houthis claimed a missile strike on King Khalid International Airport.
articles.nri_angle: Riyadh hosts ~2.5 million Indian expatriates; flight suspensions through Oct 9-16 strand travellers and disrupt festive-season travel, with free rescheduling or refunds from all four Indian carriers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Viral Video Shows IndiGo Passengers Standing in Aisle, Sharing Food Mid-Flight
articles.excerpt: Footage from a Delhi-bound IndiGo flight shows passengers standing in the aisle and passing food around despite crew warnings — the latest in a string of viral cabin-etiquette incidents.
articles.image_caption: Passengers eat homemade food on an IndiGo flight in an August 2026 viral video. A new video from a Delhi-bound flight has reignited the cabin-etiquette debate.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs flying Indian domestic routes share cabins with this behaviour — knowing crew instructions are legally binding (and that regulators fine for viral incidents) is the practical takeaway.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Launches Free EasyRoam SIM for Passengers Heading Overseas
articles.excerpt: The Air India-branded EasyRoam SIM, built with Tata Communications, offers international voice and data roaming in 30 countries — with roaming packs starting at ₹241.
articles.nri_angle: EasyRoam targets the diaspora's core travel corridors (US, UK, Gulf, Australia) with one SIM bought before departure and number retention across annual trips.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India, Singapore Airlines Drop Codeshare Booking Rule on 126 Weekly Flights
articles.excerpt: From October 15, travellers can book eligible Air India or Singapore Airlines flights between India and Singapore on a standalone basis through either carrier's channels, ending the requirement to pair codeshare legs from both airlines.
articles.image_caption: An Air India Boeing 787. The airline dropped its codeshare booking rule with Singapore Airlines on 126 weekly flights.
articles.nri_angle: The rule change directly benefits the large Indian diaspora travelling between Singapore and India, giving them simpler standalone bookings on 126 weekly flights across eight Indian cities from October 15.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cleartrip's Big Billion Days Sale: Flights From Rs 1,499, Hotels 40% Off
articles.excerpt: Cleartrip's Big Billion Days 2026 travel festival runs October 8–18 with time-slotted deals across flights, hotels, buses and trains, plus bank discounts for HDFC cardholders.
articles.image_caption: Cleartrip's Big Billion Days sale offers flights from Rs 1,499 and up to 40% off hotels.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs planning Diwali and winter-holiday trips to India, the October 8–18 window is well timed — 20% off international family bookings and discounted hotels cover both the inbound leg and the stay.

articles.title: India's First High-Altitude Snow Leopard Safari Flags Off in Ladakh
articles.excerpt: Six open-back safari vehicles rolled out of Leh during Wildlife Week for India's first high-altitude wildlife safari, initially covering Rumbak, Shang and Uley with trained local guides.
articles.image_caption: A split image showing a Himalayan river valley in Ladakh beside a close-up of a snow leopard. Six open-back safari vehicles were flagged off in Leh on Oct. 7 for India's first high-altitude wildlife safari, initially operating in Rumbak, Shang and Uley.
articles.nri_angle: A new winter anchor for diaspora India itineraries: a state-run guided snow leopard safari in Ladakh, best attempted January-March with proper acclimatization.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tourism Secretary Chairs Industry Talks on India's Travel Sector Woes
articles.excerpt: Bhuvnesh Kumar’s consultation with the travel trade comes as the ministry pushes ease-of-doing-business reforms and presses the industry to spread demand beyond overcrowded hotspots.
articles.image_caption: Industry leaders on stage at the 7th HAI Hoteliers’ Conclave in New Delhi. Tourism Secretary Bhuvnesh Kumar has chaired a fresh industry consultation on the challenges facing the travel and tourism sector.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs planning visits home benefit directly: visa categories are down from 22 to nine, e-visa covers 171 countries, and the ministry’s demand-spreading push means more bookable itineraries beyond the usual circuits.

articles.title: Air India Express Adds 135 Daily Gulf Departures in Its Biggest-Ever Winter Schedule
articles.excerpt: The Tata Group carrier's Winter 2026 network links 23 Indian cities with 12 West Asia gateways through 88 non-stop routes — a bounce-back from February's airspace crisis that goes well beyond pre-crisis levels.
articles.image_caption: An Air India Express Boeing 737 in the carrier's orange and teal livery taxis on the tarmac. The airline will operate up to 135 daily departures to West Asia under its Winter 2026 schedule, its largest ever.
articles.nri_angle: Air India Express's biggest-ever winter schedule gives Gulf-based NRIs more direct flights from 23 Indian cities — the payoff matters most for Diwali and year-end travel.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Drops Delhi Baggage Re-Check as It Eyes New Australian Routes
articles.excerpt: The carrier's Easy Connect service lets travellers from Australia clear customs and immigration at their final Indian destination instead of Delhi, cutting minimum connection times from three hours to 60 minutes — with 10 to 12 more cities set to join within six months.
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft at JFK. The carrier is scrapping Delhi baggage re-checks for Australia connections under its new Easy Connect service.
articles.nri_angle: The change directly serves the Australia–India visiting-friends-and-relatives corridor, where nearly 60% of Air India's Australian traffic flies on to hometowns beyond Delhi.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: 10 to 12 new cities expected within six months.
Potential new destinations include Goa, Kochi, Guwahati.

articles.title: South India's Travel Market Takes Centre Stage at TTF Hyderabad 2026
articles.excerpt: The Travel & Tourism Fair returns to Hyderabad's HITEX Exhibition Centre October 9–11 with 150+ exhibitors, opening to the public on the final day and a half.
articles.image_caption: Hyderabad's Charminar. The city hosted the Travel and Tourism Fair (TTF) 2026, spotlighting South India's travel market.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs planning winter trips home get a practical booking window: the fair's consumer days (Oct 10–11) land at the start of the holiday travel season, with strong Telangana and Andhra Pradesh representation for South India itineraries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Ends Mainline International Flights From Chennai, Hands Singapore Route to Express
articles.excerpt: Chennai–Singapore goes twice-daily on Air India Express 737 MAX 8s from October 25, while mainline adds a daily Chennai–Muscat service — part of a group-wide winter reshuffle that also drops Copenhagen.
articles.image_caption: An Air India Express Boeing 737 takes off from a runway. The carrier takes over the Chennai–Singapore route from mainline Air India on October 25, operating it twice daily.
articles.nri_angle: Chennai–Singapore is a lifeline corridor for the Tamil diaspora; the route keeps 14 weekly flights but shifts to a low-cost cabin, changing baggage, meal and loyalty rules for regular flyers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
